purpose: Canonical index for AI-connectable agents, Skills, MCP servers, APIs, CLIs, native AI surfaces and governed reference tools used or considered by T-one.
truth_rules: A listed capability is not a verified live connection unless current_status is verified_connected.
Internal Skills without external authorization may research, audit and draft only.
Every executable authorization is isolated by tenant, project, platform, country_site, store_binding and commerce_mode.
Official store and ERP data outrank third-party observed data; estimates never replace orders, settlement, inventory or profit truth.
Unknown Skills, repositories and collectors are blocked from automatic installation or credential access.
External writes, spending, messages, payments, refunds, shipping and publishing require owner approval.

status_vocabulary.verified_connected: A real connection and bounded readback have been verified.
status_vocabulary.internal_ready: Local Skill or workflow is present; external authorization may still be absent.
status_vocabulary.readonly_candidate: Eligible for a scoped read-only pilot after contract and credential review.
status_vocabulary.api_adapter_candidate: Official or vendor API exists and requires a governed T-one adapter.
status_vocabulary.directory_only: Discovery/catalog layer only; each child Skill requires separate review.
status_vocabulary.manual_or_export: Usable through a web UI, extension or export but not verified as an external agent interface.
status_vocabulary.reference_only: Use design or taxonomy ideas only; do not connect runtime or credentials.
status_vocabulary.blocked: Not allowed until the stated legal, security, license or ownership blocker is resolved.
status_vocabulary.paused_by_owner: Do not research live, request credentials or call the service until explicitly resumed.
status_vocabulary.not_configured: Connector contract exists locally but no real account is connected.

user_highlighted_sources.name: LinkFox Skills
user_highlighted_sources.next_gate: Use only linkfox-ai/linkfox-skills as canonical upstream. Current tree has 190 Skills although README says 118. Per-Skill archive, commit, hash, license, provider data rights, network, cost, credential and action review is required. Bulk install, automatic feedback, phone/SMS registration, API-key generation, subscription/payment, plaintext token storage and store writes remain blocked; w9uk5ie8v/LinkFoxSkills is an unlicensed rejected snapshot.

user_highlighted_sources.next_gate: GitHub Skill content is MIT and reference-only. BrowserAct CLI, Skill Forge, cloud API, stealth, proxy, CAPTCHA, profile import, logged-in sessions and internal-endpoint exploration remain blocked pending source, license, security, target-site terms and data-processing review.

user_highlighted_sources.name: IvyeaOps
user_highlighted_sources.next_gate: Do not install or connect credentials. AGPL runtime integration, self-update, default admin credential, SellerSprite key transport, Lingxing/store authorization and composite tenant/project/store/site/mode isolation must be resolved first; Amazon remains paused by owner.

user_highlighted_sources.name: Letta / Letta Code
user_highlighted_sources.next_gate: The linked letta repo is legacy. Do not install Letta Code or connect Cloud, model keys, MCP, channels or real data. Any pilot must force deny-by-default permissions, disable telemetry, provide an actual Windows sandbox, disable self-modification and external Skill installation, and add T-one composite execution identity isolation.

user_highlighted_sources.name: Super Sales Agent
user_highlighted_sources.next_gate: Reuse only the admitted sales workflow patterns. Do not install the runtime or Skills, import bundled business artifacts, read mail, write CRM, send quotations/messages, or enable auto-evolution. Replace in-memory events and simulated recovery success before any isolated synthetic pilot.

social_content_claim_audits.source: Douyin note 7650086656372926961 by 小L在跨境
social_content_claim_audits.verdict: Mostly maps to real LinkFox API-backed Skills, but requires vendor keys, points, upstream data services and per-Skill review. Ruiguan naming has drifted into multiple current skills.
The six entries mix a data platform, creative SaaS, hosted agent, one API-backed Skill, a generic memory Skill and a Skill marketplace; they are not six equivalent Codex Skills.

This is the same six-item claim set as the previously audited 千雪AI video, only reordered. It mixes a hosted agent, generic memory Skill, creative SaaS, one API-backed Amazon Skill, an Amazon data platform and a Skill marketplace; no new connector or Skill asset was discovered.
